name: Citadel Frostward

civilization.name: The Frostward Collective
civilization.notes: A cold-adapted humanoid species that has built an industrial civilization within ice citadel structures, using geothermal energy to sustain manufacturing and agriculture.

geological_features: Ice shelf coastlines along a partially frozen sea
specific_features: Ice citadel structures modified by the Frostward Collective into cities
Geothermal-powered industrial complexes in hot spring valleys
description: Citadel Frostward is a large ice world whose breathable atmosphere and geothermal activity have permitted the emergence of complex life and, ultimately, civilization. The surface is predominantly frozen tundra, but geothermal hotspots create valleys of relative warmth where hot springs sustain pockets of vegetation and the Frostward Collective has built its industrial centers. Natural ice formations shaped by geothermal venting have been modified into the citadel-cities that give the planet its name.

The cold is pervasive but not lethal, the breathable atmosphere retaining just enough geothermal warmth to prevent the oceans from freezing entirely. A partially frozen sea dominates the southern hemisphere, its ice shelf coastline advancing and retreating with the seasons. The sky is a pale, washed blue, and snow falls with quiet frequency, accumulating on the tundra plains in deep, sculpted drifts.

The Frostward Collective has adapted brilliantly to their cold world, developing geothermal-powered industry, underground agriculture in heated caverns, and a material culture centered on ice and metal. Their citadel-cities are engineering marvels -- natural ice formations enlarged and reinforced with structural metal, heated from within by geothermal taps, their interiors warm and productive while their exteriors present walls of ice to the frozen landscape. Their technology is pre-spacefaring but advancing rapidly.

Contact with the Frostward Collective has been productive, the civilization displaying a pragmatic openness to trade and knowledge exchange rare among pre-spacefaring species. They are particularly interested in atmospheric engineering technologies that could warm their world incrementally, and they offer in exchange unique metallurgical techniques developed for extreme cold conditions. Citadel Frostward is a world on the cusp of reaching outward -- and the manner of its first steps into the wider galaxy will be shaped by whoever guides them.
